top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic Bergen-Voss' demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
Bergen-Voss' mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 107 miles.
64ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At mile 60 of 107, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
At Bergen-Voss, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
6,890ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Bergen-Voss. Train it until it feels boring.
6,890ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Bergen-Voss, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 6,890ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 107 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on mixed terrain. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Bergen-Voss’s 107 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at Bergen-Voss. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Bergen-Voss requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, Road Specific, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 107 miles of mixed terrain in Bergen to Voss, Norway.
